label: sparse mid-original-phase conjunction (after z, first token i/d/a/u/v)
explanation: Very sparse (0.02% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at t>=3 (peaking at t=4), and almost never at the delimiter or during copying. Its strongest correlates are a previous input of z (17x lift, 48% of mass), first original token i (13x, 46% of mass; d/a/v/u also enriched), current input among 3/0/e/n/l/s, and first occurrence of the input token. Each of these is individually far too common (adding prev_tok==z alone gives precision 1%), and the best conjunction reaches only dev F1 0.18. It looks like a narrow region of hidden-state space reached through many different token histories, which these variables do not capture. Magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.24). No modulator of magnitude was established beyond slightly higher coverage of top-quartile activations by the z/i conjunction.
